about: Evidence each gate needs before it can LOCK (stagegate.mjs). measured = a tool run that must exit 0; made = the maker's own files; judged = by: agent:<id> or person:<name>, never the maker; approved = review/approvals.json by the gate's approver: "kai" only at a Kai touchpoint (touch), else an independent reviewer whose verdict is READY. A run or calibrated review marked advisory is shown, never blocks: its result is on the gate page. A film may add evidence in review/gates.local.json, never remove it.

touchpoints.title: look + colour
touchpoints.records: colour-script.json approved: { by: "kai", at } (copied from the series look Kai picked)

touchpoints.title: whole film at 1x, notes per segment
touchpoints.records: review/approvals.json "5": { by: "kai", at, notes } + his notes in review/retakes.json

touchpoints.title: change of approach
touchpoints.per: when retakes.mjs reports PREMISE (2 failed rounds on one shot and fault kind), or a gate FAIL can only end by a waiver or by dropping a decision Kai approved
touchpoints.records: a PREMISE pick: review/retakes.json k3: [{ shot, kind, round, pick, at }]; a waiver or override: DECISIONS.json { waives | conflict, by: "kai", at, status: "approved" } (kituse.mjs, colourgate.mjs, scriptlint.mjs)
